params.body:
Companion to gentells-site #228.

Since #369, Intelligence opens the Observatory to read. The unlisted `observatory` plan held the same abilities and limits, so it no longer does anything Intelligence does not.

- `packages/core/plans.mjs`: `observatory` leaves `DEFAULTS` and `PLAN_ORDER`. A saved offer that still carries an `observatory` row is ignored, because `getPlans` reads only the plans in `PLAN_ORDER`. The next save on Settings > Plans drops it.
- The projection stops sending the row. The site already ignores a plan it has no defaults for (#228).
- Tests: the plans test checks that Intelligence opens the Observatory and that no `observatory` plan exists. The guest login test uses an Intelligence account.

Full suite 1329/1335; the 6 failures are the known report-render tests that need pdftoppm.
